purpose: Verify a generic CLI invocation contract can be inferred from pinned supplier probe evidence and a plain goal without task-specific adapter code.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python canonical/runtime/cli_contract_inference.py canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-APT-CLI-GENERIC-PROBE-QR-001__RESULT.json 'Generate a QR code image for the text PROJECT BRAIN and save it as canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PROJECT_BRAIN_QR.png.' canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-CLI-CONTRACT-INFERENCE-QR-001__RESULT.json
python - <<'PY'
import json
x=json.load(open('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-CLI-CONTRACT-INFERENCE-QR-001__RESULT.json'))

assert x['argv_template']==['qrencode','-o','${input.output_path}','${input.text}']

print('GENERIC_CLI_CONTRACT_INFERENCE_COMPLETE')
